description: CTA - 'L' (Rail) Lines is a dataset listed in City of Chicago open data portal (data.cityofchicago.org), an open data portal (Socrata) of a city, published or maintained by City of Chicago. Lines representing approximately where the CTA rail lines are. This dataset is in a format for spatial datasets that is inherently tabular but allows for a map as a derived view. Please click the indicated link below for such a map. Coverage: Chicago. The portal files it under the category Transportation. Its tags are transportation, rail, public transit, sustainability, cta. The table has 6 columns. Attribution on the portal: City of Chicago. The portal shows 2024-07-23 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is see the terms of use on the portal (no named licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-cityofchicago-org-portal.
